item.title: GOP candidate for governor promises to establish UP "ambassador" role if elected
item.description: Tom Leonard, Republican gubernatorial candidate, has pledged to create a new position - an "Ambassador to the Upper Peninsula" - and open a permanent executive office in the U.P. if he is elected governor, in order to give the region a more direct line to the governor's office and ensure its priorities are reflected in state policy.
